adds.title: UN Independent Expert on SOGI, Report on the visit to Albania (A/HRC/59/43/Add.1)
adds.summary: UN Independent Expert Graeme Reid's country-visit report on Albania (A/HRC/59/43/Add.1, 17 Jun 2025), para. 70: transgender people in Albania remain particularly vulnerable owing to the absence of legal gender recognition, which exposes them to heightened risks of violence, discrimination and arbitrary treatment; without legal documents aligned with their gender identity, transgender people are susceptible to mistreatment by authorities, including 'increased vulnerability within detention facilities', plus difficulties in everyday interactions with public institutions. The report also notes 43% of surveyed LGBT individuals reported violence or discrimination within the prior two years and 83% of victims did not report to authorities. No birth-sex vs identity placement rule, special trans unit, or solitary/segregation practice for Albanian prisons is documented in the report.

records.note: Albania: no documented policy, special unit, or case law on where trans prisoners are housed (birth-sex vs identity placement, solitary/segregation, cases/rulings). Only detention-specific finding located: the UN IE on SOGI visit report (A/HRC/59/43/Add.1, 17 Jun 2025, para. 70) records that without legal gender recognition transgender people face 'increased vulnerability within detention facilities' and heightened risk of arbitrary treatment by authorities — consistent with document-based (birth-sex) custodial handling but not explicit. Cached ILGA-Europe Annual Review 2024 Albania chapter has no prison content. Adds: 1 verified source.

no prison-housing data found. Wikipedia full-text search surfaced nothing on trans prisoner housing in North Macedonia; both candidate fetches failed (US State Dept 2023 Human Rights Report returned a 'Technical Difficulties' page; the ILGA-Europe 2025 annual-review PDF URL returned non-PDF HTML). Cached ILGA-Europe Annual Review 2024 and LGBTI Enlargement Review 2024 mention detention only in non-trans contexts (police detention of LGBTI human-rights defenders, sex workers), not prison placement. No documented birth-sex vs identity placement rule, special unit, solitary/segregation practice, or case/ruling for North Macedonia located.
